[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''Rebecca J. Glasgow''' was born on 13 September 1817 and died on 25 July 1837. Alexander Brown's 1895 family history states that [[McCulloch-655|Nancy Ellis McCulloch Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-648|Joseph Glasgow]] had two children and names Rebecca first, with these exact dates.<ref name="Brown1895">Alexander Brown, ''The Cabells and Their Kin'' (Boston: Houghton, Mifflin and Company, 1895), pp. 292–293; [https://play.google.com/books/reader?id=BAo7AAAAMAAJ&printsec=frontcover&output=reader&hl=en&pg=GBS.PA293 digital copy].</ref>
